mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size for my tiny home shell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size for your tiny home shell depends on several factors: the number of occupants, your lifestyle, intended use (full-time living, guest house, office), and local zoning restrictions. Consider how much storage space you need, if you require a dedicated workspace, and what amenities are essential. Think about future needs as well. We can help you evaluate different dimensions and layouts during our consultation to ensure the shell meets your functional and aesthetic requirements.
